verdict.rationale: The pack shows a 1Password desktop app exists. The CLI integrates with 'your 1Password app' using Touch ID or Windows Hello, the SSH and Git features run 'from the 1Password app', and users describe desktop apps that 'work great' (Electron-based). One-time-password storage and access is documented, but not specifically on the desktop, and there is no first-party desktop app documentation. An old comment about a missing Linux client points to a platform gap, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party desktop app docs, explicit evidence that OTP codes are shown in the desktop app, and confirmed coverage across desktop operating systems.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
